card.name: Citation punctuation in Mexican ecology papers
card.fires_on: Punctuation or spaces right after "et al" or an author name inside a citation, and numbers in addresses or dates, in a Mexican ecology journal article.

modes.label: After et al in citations
modes.description: The period-comma after "et al" in a parenthetical reference, just before the year.
modes.example: (e.g., Watkinson and Gill, 2002; Watkinson et al<<.,>> 2004)

modes.label: Spaces and digits in Mexican journal text
modes.description: A space or digit in an address, journal header or year in a Mexican article.

card.writes: It adds a lean toward Spanish-speaking and Latin American names and places, as the suppressed tokens suggest, with weak other effects.
card.plain: It fires on citation marks and numbers in a Mexican scientific paper about climate and ecology.
